title: 28 U.S.C. § 1441 — removal
summary: Removal transfers an eligible action from state court to federal court through a procedure authorized by Congress. It ordinarily depends on federal original jurisdiction and the removing party’s statutory role.

sections.Role in the course: Removal transfers an eligible action from state court to federal court through a procedure authorized by Congress. It ordinarily depends on federal original jurisdiction and the removing party’s statutory role.
sections.What to examine: Identify the original complaint, the party seeking removal, the jurisdictional basis, the destination federal court, and the procedural requirements. Check consent, timing, amount allegations, and special statutes. Distinguish original defendants from plaintiffs or counterclaim defendants as the cases require.
